command: set -euo pipefail; test -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; adb start-server >/dev/null; mapfile -t devices < <(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); test "${#devices[@]}" -eq 1; serial="${devices[0]}"; model="$(adb -s "$serial" shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r')"; test "$model" = "SM-S906B"; echo DEVICE_OK=$serial:$model
